answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 46576 Country: India Title: Intercourse Question: In my house I have one small hall and one kitchen only, no other area left to eat or sleep. Is it permissible in Islam to sleep or intercourse with wife in the same place where we sit and eat on dastarkhan. Answer ID: 46576 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1137/882/B=1434) Yes, it is lawful to have intercourse with wife on the said place. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
